Complete pending-candidate snapshots at each selection; network distances use the cached directed-edge graph

metadata.goal: Analyze how the courier prioritizes delivery tasks during the workday.
metadata.dataset_description: Constructed LaDe-style Shanghai case: 59 tasks, 1 courier(s), 1 courier-workday trajectories and 5488 GPS points. Routes follow the archived local OSM street network with oneway directions respected; restricted-access ways and expressways are excluded. Turn-restriction relations are not modeled. AOIs are constructed road-centered catchments, not official polygons. All times are local Shanghai time. Each task is accepted before selection and completion; the full candidate table records every pending task at each decision. speed_kmh is the mean speed of the immediately preceding GPS segment (zero during waiting/service), not an instantaneous endpoint speed. Empty last_near_destination_before_acceptance means no prior GPS observation within 250 m. Deadline-expired observations remain valid and represent late tasks; this is not an all-on-time dataset.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def backlog_priority(df,user_df,decisions):
    d=decisions[decisions.selected & decisions.pending_count.ge(2)].copy()
    d['acceptance_rank_fraction']=(d.acceptance_rank-1)/(d.pending_count-1)
    d['proximity_rank_fraction']=(d.proximity_rank-1)/(d.pending_count-1)
    d['backlog']=np.where(d.pending_count>=8,'High (8+)','Low (2–7)')
    means=d.groupby('backlog')[['acceptance_rank_fraction','proximity_rank_fraction']].mean()
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    means.reindex(['Low (2–7)','High (8+)']).plot.bar(ax=axes[0],color=['#527dac','#ca8647'],rot=0)
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Pending workload',ylabel='Mean normalized rank (lower = higher priority)',title='Closer destinations versus earlier acceptances',ylim=(0,1))
    axes[0].legend(['Acceptance time: 0 = earliest accepted','Road distance: 0 = nearest destination'],fontsize=8)
    axes[1].scatter(d.pending_count,d.acceptance_rank_fraction,c='#527dac',alpha=.65,label='Acceptance time: 0 = earliest accepted')
    axes[1].scatter(d.pending_count,d.proximity_rank_fraction,c='#ca8647',marker='x',alpha=.8,label='Road distance: 0 = nearest destination')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Pending tasks at selection',ylabel='Normalized selected-task rank',title='Time priority and spatial priority at each decision',ylim=(-.05,1.3))
    axes[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left')
    return {'selected_decisions':len(d),'mean_normalized_ranks':means.to_dict()}

evidence = backlog_priority(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

plot.description: Each point is a distinct simultaneously pending task pair, using its first qualifying snapshot. The urgent task has at most 20 minutes remaining (including overdue), the closer loose-window task at least 40 minutes. import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def deadline_priority(df,user_df,decisions):
    pairs={}
    order=df.set_index('task_id').completion_order
    for _,q in decisions.groupby('decision_id',sort=False):
        for _,urgent in q[q.remaining_window_min.le(20)].iterrows():
            for _,loose in q[(q.remaining_window_min>=40)&(q.candidate_distance_km<urgent.candidate_distance_km)].iterrows():
                key=(urgent.candidate_task_id,loose.candidate_task_id)
                pairs.setdefault(key,{'urgent':key[0],'loose':key[1],
                    'urgent_distance':urgent.candidate_distance_km,'loose_distance':loose.candidate_distance_km,
                    'urgent_remaining':urgent.remaining_window_min,'loose_remaining':loose.remaining_window_min,
                    'urgent_first':bool(order[key[0]]<order[key[1]])})
    pairs=pd.DataFrame(pairs.values());assert len(pairs)
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    rates=pairs.urgent_first.value_counts().reindex([True,False],fill_value=0)
    axes[0].bar(['Urgent task first','Closer loose task first'],rates,color=['#c27548','#6b8da4'])
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Distinct simultaneously pending task pairs',title='Deadline priority can outweigh proximity')
    for i,v in enumerate(rates):axes[0].text(i,v+.2,str(v),ha='center')
    for first,color,label in [(True,'#c27548','Farther urgent task completed first'),
                              (False,'#6b8da4','Closer loose-window task completed first')]:
        subset=pairs[pairs.urgent_first==first]
        axes[1].scatter(subset.loose_distance,subset.urgent_distance,color=color,alpha=.7,
            label=f'{label} ({len(subset)} pairs)')
    lim=max(pairs.urgent_distance.max(),pairs.loose_distance.max())*1.05
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Road distance to closer, loose-window task (km)',
        ylabel='Road distance to farther, urgent task (km)',
        title='Each point = one pending task pair\nColor shows which task was completed first')
    axes[1].legend(loc='lower right',fontsize=7,framealpha=.95)
    axes[1].text(.03,.97,'Urgent: ≤20 min to deadline (including overdue)\nLoose: ≥40 min to deadline\nOnly pairs with the urgent task farther away are included.',
        transform=axes[1].transAxes,ha='left',va='top',fontsize=7,
        bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.9})
    axes[1].set_ylim(-.15,lim*1.22)
    return {'urgent_threshold_min':20,'loose_threshold_min':40,'distinct_pairs':len(pairs),
            'distinct_urgent_tasks':int(pairs.urgent.nunique()),'urgent_completed_first_share':float(pairs.urgent_first.mean())}

evidence = deadline_priority(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import kendalltau
decisions = pd.read_csv("decision_candidates.csv")

def acceptance_location(df,user_df,decisions):
    near=df[df.acceptance_distance_km<=.25].copy()
    away=df[(df.acceptance_distance_km>=.8)&df.last_near_destination_before_acceptance.notna()].copy()
    cohorts=[near,away];labels=['Near at acceptance','Previously near, now away']
    fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.6),constrained_layout=True)
    axes[0].boxplot([q.accept_to_completion_min for q in cohorts],tick_labels=labels,showfliers=False)
    for i,q in enumerate(cohorts,1):
        jitter=np.linspace(-.12,.12,len(q))
        axes[0].scatter(i+jitter,q.accept_to_completion_min,s=25,alpha=.65,color=['#548578','#be8452'][i-1])
        ordered=np.sort(q.accept_to_completion_min)
        axes[1].step(ordered,np.arange(1,len(q)+1)/len(q),where='post',label=f'{labels[i-1]} (n={len(q)})')
    axes[0].set(ylabel='Acceptance → completion (minutes)',title='Tasks accepted locally tend to finish sooner')
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Minutes since acceptance',ylabel='Fraction completed',title='Completion-delay distributions');axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
    return {'near_threshold_km':.25,'away_threshold_km':.8,'near_tasks':len(near),'previously_near_away_tasks':len(away),
            'median_minutes_near':float(near.accept_to_completion_min.median()),
            'median_minutes_away':float(away.accept_to_completion_min.median()),
            'near_faster_pairwise_share':float((near.accept_to_completion_min.to_numpy()[:,None]<away.accept_to_completion_min.to_numpy()).mean())}

evidence = acceptance_location(df, user_df, decisions)
print(evidence)
plt.show()
